## Change basis

- [ ] I opened the current version of every file I changed before modifying it.
- [ ] I searched the current repository before claiming anything was missing.
- [ ] I inspected the current CI workflow and relevant test configuration before changing any CI/test claim.
- [ ] If this PR came from an earlier audit, I re-checked that recommendation against the current branch state.

## Post-change verification

- [ ] I inspected the actual diff between the PR base and head.
- [ ] I confirmed every changed file is intentional.
- [ ] I confirmed the final claims do not exceed what the current implementation establishes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, or documented why they could not be run.
